page.description: MidnightBSD editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A FreeBSD-derived desktop operating system with Xfce as the default (and only) desktop, released for amd64 and i386 with bootonly ISO, disc1 ISO, and USB memstick images.
pros: SHA-256 checksums published per release in CHECKSUM.SHA256
Both amd64 and i386 images available
Xfce desktop with mport graphical package manager
cons: No handbook, install guide, or documentation site (all return 404)
Jurisdiction restriction prohibits use in California and Brazil
Release directory has no separate rescue or live image
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for MidnightBSD; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write bootonly or disc1 ISO to USB with dd; write memstick/mini-memstick images with dd. The installer uses FreeBSD bsdinstall.

editions.name: Desktop (amd64 + i386)
editions.description: Single edition with Xfce desktop; bootonly ISO, full disc1 ISO, USB memstick, and mini-memstick images per architecture.
editions.usbNote: Use dd or balenaEtcher to write images. Memstick images are designed for USB media.
